passages.note: House Third Reading roll call on SB1165; Martinez voted Y, not near-unanimous (31-24-5-0-0).

passages.provision_quote: B. Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex. C. This section does not restrict the eligibility of any student to participate in any interscholastic or intramural athletic team or sport designated as being for "males", "men" or "boys" or designated as "coed" or "mixed".
passages.note: Enacted provision (Chapter 106) restricts only girls'/women's teams by biological sex; boys' and coed teams remain open, excluding the rung 5 full ban.
Bill status page confirms House THIRD 03/24/2022 31-24-5-0-0 PASSED and governor's signature, same instrument as the roll call and bill text.

rows.reasoning: Martinez voted Y on Arizona SB 1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose enacted text (Chapter 106) designates athletic teams by biological sex, bars students of the male sex from teams designated for females/women/girls, and does not restrict eligibility for boys' or coed teams. This matches 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth' and excludes the full ban rung since other teams remain open. The House vote (31-24-5-0-0) is not near-unanimous, and the vote falls within her House term (2021-11-01 to 2023-01-09).
